_meta.purpose: Scripted, quest-stage-gated interaction points in the world. These are the triggers that only exist while a quest is at a particular stage, which is why they live here rather than in <id>.location.json — the location schema has no notion of quest stage.
_meta.coordinateSpace: NATIVE plate px, same as <id>.location.json. QuestTriggerSystem multiplies by the location's world.scale exactly once, on load.
_meta.availabilityContract: `stages` lists the quest stage ids at which the hotspot exists at all; `timeOfDay` narrows it further. Both must pass. The predicate itself stays in QuestTriggerSystem — this file supplies WHERE and WHAT, not HOW.
